§6Alloys & Advanced Materials§f

§aBlend metals into alloys, the backbone of Thermal Expansion machines!§f

§e8§f alloys, all smelted in the §bInduction Smelter§f. You can pre-mix dust blends (shapeless crafting) before smelting to save time.

The basics: §bSteel§f (Pulverized Iron + Coal Coke), §bElectrum§f (Gold + Silver), §bInvar§f (Iron + Nickel), §bBronze§f (Copper + Tin), §bConstantan§f (Copper + Nickel). The fancy ones: §bSignalum§f and §bLumium§f use Pulverized Silver + Copper with Destabilized Redstone or Energized Glowstone (§e4:3:1§f ratio). §bEnderium§f is Platinum + Iridium + Resonant Ender.

§ePS:§f Signalum, Lumium, and Enderium unlock the top-tier Thermal Expansion machine upgrades. Check JEI for exact ratios, the 4:3:1 blend is easy to get wrong.
